item.title: South Africa’s Nedbank promises to retain NCBA staff in Kenyan takeover

item.title: Calling app Talk360 secures $1.4M secondary investment as it reaches profitability
item.description: Talk360, a South African calling app that enables worldwide calls without internet connection, has raised $1.4 million in a secondary investment.

item.title: What you need to know about M-PESA’s Ziidi Trader
item.description: The platform will enable the over 37 million M-PESA users to buy and sell stocks the same way they send money to a friend or pay for utilities like electricity. To understand why Ziidi Trader feels different, it helps to picture the before-and-after of how ordinary Kenyans have accessed capital markets.

item.title: Regulatory conditions block Access Bank’s Bidvest Bank acquisition
item.description: The collapse of the proposed acquisition has dealt a blow to the Nigerian lender’s rapid pan-African expansion strategy, which has relied heavily on acquisitions to enter tightly regulated markets.

item.title: After years on the sidelines, Africa’s telecoms return to the bond market
item.description: The telecom bond market, where companies raise debt from investors by issuing tradable securities, provides the long-term, reliable capital required to build digital infrastructure at scale.

item.title: This Kenyan startup promises school pickups digital paper trail
item.description: Terra GO is a Kenyan school transport system that logs student handovers using NFC taps, giving parents and schools verified arrival, pickup, and bus journey records.
